abilities.name: Battle Preparation
abilities.text: During Army Building, your army cannot include both the Nova Assault Mode Unit and the Nova Stealth Mode Unit.

abilities.name: Ghost Visor
abilities.text: While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Unit, they lose the HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Super Stimpack
abilities.text: This Unit gains BUFF Speed (2). Additionally, all its Weapons gain PRECISION (2).

abilities.name: Holo Decoy
abilities.text: Resolve the SUMMON (Holo Decoy) effect. Then, Holo Decoy may immediately perform a Move action.

abilities.name: Phase Reactor Suit
abilities.text: If Unengaged, resolve the PLACE (6) effect.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.
